summary.text: Carmen De La Rosa represents the 10th District on the New York City Council, which includes Washington Heights and Inwood, and was elected to the Council in November 2021.
Her Council biography says she previously served in the State Assembly, representing the 72nd District from her election in November 2016.

paragraphs.text: De La Rosa emigrated from the Dominican Republic as a child and grew up in Inwood, where she has lived her entire life, according to her Council biography.
She was elected to the State Assembly in November 2016, and the biography says she negotiated and passed the New York State DREAM Act and the Excluded Workers Fund, funded at $2.1 billion.
She won the Democratic primary on June 22, 2021, and the general election on November 2, becoming the first Dominican woman elected to represent District 10 at City Hall.
She is the mother of a daughter, Mia, and raises her in the community where her parents also live.
